title: MRI of the Lumbar Spine for Low Back Pain (Synthetic Health Plan — fictional policy)
notes: SYNTHETIC POLICY written for the Necessa demo (text embedded below). Not issued by any real payer.

sections.indication: Synthetic Health Plan considers MRI of the lumbar spine medically necessary when either of the following applies. Red flag findings are present, such as suspected cauda equina syndrome, progressive neurologic deficit, suspected spinal infection, or a history of cancer with new back pain. OR the member has low back pain with radiculopathy that persists after at least six weeks of documented conservative care and the member is a candidate for surgery or interventional treatment. Imaging is not medically necessary for uncomplicated acute low back pain of less than six weeks without red flags.

root.label: Red flags OR persistent radiculopathy after conservative care
